QuestInfo.name: ToH: Final Round
QuestInfo.0: You've reached the final round of the Tournament of Heroes. Your opponent is a mysterious person masked with a bandana.
QuestInfo.1: The final round of the Tournament of Heroes is taking place. Your opponent is very strong, but you can do it!
QuestInfo.2: Your opponent turned out to be Arkarium, one of the Black Mage's commanders! He revealed his identity, stole 14 of the participants, and the tournament ended.

mob.0: Get into the ring! It's ON!\r\n(If you lost, forfeit the quest and try again.)
